necessary_context.applies_to: Integer lower bound and minimax bracket; finite-difference component needs only differentiability and gradient Lipschitzness.
necessary_context.content: X=B_2^d(R), C=B_2^d(R/2). F_beta(d,R) consists of convex C^1 functions f:R^d->R with globally beta-Lipschitz gradient in Euclidean norm and a unique global minimizer x_f^* in C; f^*=min_R^d f.
necessary_context.name: Objective class

necessary_context.content: At time t a deterministic Borel map Q_t:(X x R)^(t-1)->X chooses x_t from the exact history (x_i,f(x_i)); a Borel Q_out:(X x R)^T->X returns any feasible point, which need not have been queried. The unknown objective is fixed. Only exact scalar f(x) is returned; arbitrary exact-real internal computation is free. Repeated oracle calls count; reuse of an already stored value makes no new call.
necessary_context.name: Information model

necessary_context.content: N_epsilon,det-ad^val=inf{T in N_0: some deterministic T-call policy has sup_f in F_beta [f(xhat_f)-f^*]<=epsilon}; inf empty=+infinity. Q=beta R^2/epsilon; log is natural.
necessary_context.name: Minimax and accuracy notation
